events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Street, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation celebrating Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product discovery, samples, refreshments, giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary VEFB+ samples, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissants and scratch-off giveaways while supplies last. The first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The current Eventbrite listing is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and confirms September 17, 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza. Current NYC listings also describe the activation as open to the public. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video capture is disclosed for event-related brand coverage.
events.practical_notes: Use the Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite listing before traveling. Arrive near noon if the first-100 deluxe sample is the priority.

events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with a cat-themed bodega set, games, product sampling and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples, plus chances to win collectible Cat Bodega merchandise through claw-machine and scratch-off games.
events.caveats: Mars/TEMPTATIONS' current announcement confirms the physical pop-up runs September 17–19 from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery and describes it as free. Current NYC coverage explicitly calls it open to the public. No RSVP requirement was established in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation, noon–6 PM each day. Samples and prize merchandise are finite, so earlier arrival is preferable if freebies are the priority.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a complimentary mini Apothékary tincture. A separate free gift with purchase is also promoted.
events.caveats: The current Eventbrite listing is organized by Apothékary and confirms September 18 from 1–9 PM and September 19–20 from 9 AM–9 PM at 1542 3rd Avenue. Apothékary's current social post independently promotes the same three-day activation. Freebies are while supplies last; the 20% discount and free gift with purchase are retail promotions, not admission requirements.
events.practical_notes: Use the Apothékary organizer Eventbrite listing before traveling. Each date has its own hours; arrive near opening for the first-50 mini tincture.
